clusters.headline: Krakow Shooting Suspect Dies Following Fatal Market Square Attack
aiSummaryBullets: The 24-year-old suspect behind the mass shooting in a Krakow market square has died in a hospital following injuries sustained in a police shootout.
Polish officials have officially classified the event as a terrorist offense and are currently investigating whether the individual acted alone.

clusters.headline: Tens Of Thousands Attend Annual Nationalist March In Warsaw Poland
aiSummaryBullets: Large crowds of nationalist supporters gathered in Warsaw for the annual November 11 Independence Day commemoration.
The demonstration occurred shortly after a fatal shooting incident in Krakow which has impacted national discourse.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Tusk Declares Krakow Shooting A Terrorist Attack
aiSummaryBullets: A total of nine people have been confirmed dead following the Krakow shooting incident and the subsequent discovery of bodies at the suspect's home.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has officially designated the attack as an act of terrorism, noting the unprecedented nature of the event.
